translation_notes: Direct mapping of g.query(TEXT) to s{ }: the UNION/FILTER query needs no rewrite beyond the island syntax. Wrote sample1.turtle as the fixture graph (not present in the extracted region) with two reified-statement encodings (explicit rdf:Statement/rdf:predicate, and a node whose own rdf:type is the predicate), plus a plain triple and an incomplete rdf:Statement as non-matching neighbours.

repair.driver: sample1.turtle gains four nodes, each deciding one part of the query: _:untyped (reification triples, no rdf:type), _:otherlink (ex:kind rdf:Statement), _:claim (typed ex:Claim with an rdf:predicate: only the second UNION branch answers) and _:st1dup (same triple as _:st1, for DISTINCT); driver docstring says what each node makes visible. The module-state oracle compares d and res, i.e. what output.json receives.
